limitations: Independent receptivity and arrivals, no persistence or rescue between episodes, equal expected pulse size and stochastic total budget, hard two-founder threshold; no unbalanced dose or ecological field prescription.
scientific_integrity: An analytic result for equal expected Poisson doses and independent two-founder establishment; numerical checks are supplemental, not infinite proof. Historical priority remains provisional because a relevant 1999 paper could not be fully inspected.
title: An exact introduction-count staircase under two-founder thresholds and intermittent habitat receptivity
